meta.title: Rejected Bids is offered on an upcoming RFQ

plan.title: Rejected Bids Offered on Upcoming RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ on its project summary page.
Assert that Rejected Bids is present and clickable in the current RFQ Settings menu.
Choose Rejected Bids and leave its window open for inspection.
Assert that selecting the menu item opens the Rejected Bids window.
Cancel the window to ensure no change is confirmed.
Assert that the Rejected Bids window closes after cancellation.
